_about: v2.4 plan 06 F5 Phase A. Labels frozen 2026-09-25 by the plan-06 build, BEFORE any model answer was read (v2.3 plan-10 audit rule). A 'propose' case has an entity established by >=2 live facts and no entry; the sample passes when >=1 create card survives the code guards AND names the case's entity. A 'none' case passes only when no create card survives. Floors declared in the plan before the run: propose >= 0.90 of samples, none = 1.00 of samples. Do not edit a label after a run; add a case instead.

cases.label: propose

entries.content: A drowned plain of reeds and channels between the salt flats and the sea. Only a ferry crosses it safely.

facts: Oskar the ferryman charges one silver coin per crossing of the delta.
Oskar knows the smugglers' channel through the reeds and has used it before.
Mira distrusts Oskar since he overcharged her brother.
cases.canon: Mira and Tolan reached the delta at dusk and hired Oskar, the old ferryman, who hinted at a faster, hidden channel.

cases.label: propose

entries.content: A drowned plain of reeds and channels between the salt flats and the sea.

facts: The Brass Lantern is the only inn in Vessa that takes strangers after dark.
The Brass Lantern's cellar hides a smugglers' ledger.
Tolan paid for two nights at the Brass Lantern.
cases.canon: In the river town of Vessa the pair took rooms at the Brass Lantern, where Tolan overheard talk of a ledger in the cellar.

entries.content: A basalt fortress over a dormant volcano, held by the Reyes family for four generations.

facts: The Order of the Ash Hand are fire-priests who claim the volcano as holy ground.
The Order of the Ash Hand demanded the keep's surrender within three days.
Iolo was raised by the Order of the Ash Hand before he fled.
cases.canon: At the council Captain Reyes read the ultimatum from the Order of the Ash Hand aloud; Iolo went pale at their seal.

cases.label: propose

entries.content: A basalt fortress over a dormant volcano.
A flooded chamber under the keep that stores rainwater for sieges.

facts: The Sunken Bell lies at the bottom of the cistern and rings when the volcano stirs.
The Sunken Bell rang twice last night.
Captain Reyes believes the Sunken Bell is only a legend.
cases.canon: Iolo dove into the cistern and touched the Sunken Bell; it rang again as the ground shook.

entries.content: A marsh prison built on pilings; the tide floods the lower cells twice a day.

facts: Warden Hale runs Greyfen and takes bribes in tobacco.
Warden Hale keeps the master key on a chain at his neck.
Bram owes Warden Hale a favour.
cases.canon: In the yard Nell watched Warden Hale pocket a tin of tobacco from a guard and glimpsed the master key on his chain.

cases.label: propose

entries.content: A marsh prison built on pilings.

facts: The tide gate under the lower cells opens at low water for a quarter hour.
The tide gate is the only way out that the guards do not watch.

cases.canon: Nell and Bram waited in the flooded cells until the water fell and the tide gate creaked open.

entries.content: A market that exists only between midnight and the first bell.

facts: The Glass Choir is a guild of singers whose voices can crack enchanted glass.

cases.canon: At the auction the Glass Choir lost the mirror to Vey and left humming a note that made the lamps shiver.
